Subject: MAP + timeline for pilot evaluation

Hi Priya —

Thanks for yesterday's demo. Our leadership liked the latency/cost story; next step for us is a concrete mutual action plan so we can align stakeholders and procurement. Two asks:

1) Can you share a MAP template (Doc + Slides) we can adapt?
2) We have an internal target to decide on pilots by mid-February — can you propose a timeline and the key milestones procurement will need (PO, SOW, SOC2 evidence)?

We'd like to include Product (me), Security (cc'd procurement), and Legal later.

Appreciate a starter draft — Elena

Elena Torres

Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 05 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP + timeline for pilot evaluation

Elena — thanks, glad the demo clicked. Attached are two starter artifacts we use for early-stage pilots: a DOC MAP template (tasks, owners, acceptance criteria) and a condensed SLIDES acceptance slate for execs. I also included a short pricing estimate and a SOC2 summary we can share with procurement.

High level proposal (recommendation):
- 45-day acceptance sprint (minimum viable pilot): 0–14d tech validation, 15–30d feature/quality checks + stakeholder demos, 31–45d acceptance + handoff.
- Milestones (what procurement/legal typically asks for):
  * PO by decision date (we can accept PO or signature on SOW)
  * SOC2 summary + contact for audit evidence (attached)
  * Estimated spend and invoicing cadence (attached pricing_estimate)

Next steps I propose:
1) I drop a lightweight MAP draft into a shared GDoc (editable) — we can co-author.
2) Quick 30m kickoff with Product + Security next week to lock tech milestones.
3) Agree on final decision date (you suggested mid-Feb).

Attachments included: Veridian_MAP_template_v1.docx, 45-day_acceptance_slate_v1.pptx, SOC2-summary-redwood.pdf, pricing_estimate-Veridian-VD-3741.xlsx

GDrive links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=mapsheet-VD-3741-gdoc  | https://drive.google.com/open?id=acceptance-slate-VD-3741-slides

If that plan sounds good I can seed the doc by end of day.

--

Thanks Priya — the artifacts look useful. A couple of procurement notes so we can align internally:

- Decision window: we need final commitment (PO or signed SOW) by 2026-02-15 to meet our Q1 budget.
- Security: SOC2 summary is good; procurement will request the SOC2 point-of-contact and an NDA/redlines path for restricted data.
- Pricing: can you confirm whether the estimate assumes usage-based billing or a short-term seat/commit model for the 45-day pilot? Also need invoice remit details for the PO.

Marissa — can your team cover a 1-hour kickoff to walk stakeholders through the slate (internal audience ~8 people)? Prefer Wed/Thu next week between 10–12 PT.

Elena
